31386.a:
- **Image** — read-only layer'lar to'plami + metadata (CMD, ENV, EXPOSE). O'zgarmas, tag/digest bilan aniqlanadi.
- **Container** — image ustiga qo'shilgan yupqa **writable layer** + namespace/cgroup bilan izolyatsiya qilingan jarayon.
- Bitta image'dan ko'p container ishga tushadi; ular image layer'larini **ulashadi** (copy-on-write).
- Container o'chirilsa (`docker rm`) writable layer ham yo'qoladi — ma'lumot kerak bo'lsa **volume**.

```sh
docker pull nginx:1.27      # image
docker run -d --name web nginx:1.27   # container
docker ps -a; docker images
```

31387.a:
| Instruksiya | Qachon ishlaydi | Izoh |
|---|---|---|
| `FROM` | build | asos image, multi-stage'da bir necha marta |
| `RUN` | build | buyruq bajaradi, **yangi layer** yaratadi |
| `COPY` / `ADD` | build | fayl ko'chiradi; `ADD` URL/tar ochadi — odatda `COPY` afzal |
| `ENV` / `ARG` | build (+run) | `ARG` faqat build paytida, `ENV` container'da ham |
| `WORKDIR` | build | ishchi papka |
| `EXPOSE` | — | faqat **hujjat**; portni `-p` ochadi |
| `USER` | run | root bo'lmagan user |
| `ENTRYPOINT` | run | doimiy dastur |
| `CMD` | run | default argument/buyruq, `docker run img X` bilan almashadi |

31388.a:
```sh
docker run -d --rm --name api \
  -p 8080:80 \            # host 8080 -> container 80
  -v data:/var/lib/app \  # named volume
  -v $PWD/conf:/etc/app:ro \  # bind mount, read-only
  -e LOG_LEVEL=debug \
  myapp:1.2
```
- `-p 127.0.0.1:8080:80` — faqat localhost'da ochish (default `0.0.0.0` — hamma interfeys!).
- `-it` — interaktiv terminal; `--restart unless-stopped` — avtomatik qayta ishga tushirish.

31389.a:
- **Named volume** (`-v data:/path`) — Docker boshqaradi, backup/migratsiya oson, host yo'lga bog'liq emas. **Production DB uchun shu.**
- **Bind mount** (`-v /host/path:/path`) — hostdagi aniq papka; dev'da kodni jonli o'zgartirish uchun. Kamchilik: host strukturasi va UID/permission muammolari.
- **tmpfs** (`--tmpfs /tmp`) — RAM'da, container to'xtasa yo'qoladi; secret/vaqtinchalik fayllar uchun.
- Gotcha: bo'sh named volume image'dagi fayllar bilan **to'ldiriladi**, bind mount esa image papkasini **yashiradi**.

31390.a:
- Cache kaliti: instruksiya matni + (COPY/ADD uchun) fayl checksum'i + oldingi layer.
- Bir layer invalid bo'lsa — **keyingi barcha layer'lar** qayta quriladi.

```dockerfile
FROM golang:1.23 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download          # dependency o'zgarmasa cache
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /app ./cmd/api
```
- BuildKit: `RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/go-build` — build cache layer'dan tashqarida.
- `.dockerignore` — `.git`, `node_modules` context'ga kirmasin (cache buzilmasin, build tez).

31391.a:
```dockerfile
ENTRYPOINT ["/app"]
CMD ["--port=8080"]
# docker run img --port=9000  -> /app --port=9000
```
- **Exec form** `["/app"]` — /app PID 1, `SIGTERM` to'g'ridan-to'g'ri keladi → graceful shutdown.
- **Shell form** `CMD /app` — `/bin/sh -c /app`; sh PID 1, signalni uzatmaydi → 10s keyin `SIGKILL`.
- Wrapper script ishlatsang oxirida `exec "$@"`.
- PID 1 zombie'larni yig'maydi — kerak bo'lsa `--init` (tini).

31392.a:
- **bridge** (default `docker0`) — har container o'z IP, chiqishda NAT, kirishga `-p`.
- **User-defined bridge** (`docker network create app`) — **container nomi bo'yicha DNS** ishlaydi; default bridge'da yo'q.
- **host** — izolyatsiya yo'q, port mapping kerak emas, tez (faqat Linux).
- **none** — faqat loopback.
- **overlay** — VXLAN orqali bir necha host (Swarm), **macvlan** — container'ga fizik tarmoqda MAC.
```sh
docker network create app
docker run -d --network app --name db postgres
docker run --network app alpine ping db
```

31393.a:
- `docker stop -t 30 api` — `SIGTERM`, 30s kutadi, keyin `SIGKILL`. `STOPSIGNAL` Dockerfile'da o'zgartiriladi.
- `docker kill` — darhol `SIGKILL`; exit code 137.
- Restart policy:
  - `no` — default
  - `on-failure:5` — non-zero exit'da, 5 martagacha
  - `always` — har doim, daemon restartda ham (qo'lda stop qilinsa ham daemon restartdan keyin ko'tariladi)
  - `unless-stopped` — always, lekin qo'lda to'xtatilgan bo'lsa qolmaydi

31394.a:
```sh
docker logs -f --tail 100 api
docker exec -it api sh
docker inspect api --format '{{.State.ExitCode}} {{.State.OOMKilled}}'
docker stats            # CPU/RAM
docker events           # restart/oom hodisalari
docker cp api:/etc/app.yaml .
# shell yo'q (distroless):
docker run -it --pid=container:api --network=container:api nicolaka/netshoot
```
- Exit 137 = SIGKILL (ko'pincha OOM), 143 = SIGTERM, 139 = segfault.

31395.a:
- **Namespace** — nimani ko'radi; **cgroups** — qancha ishlatadi; **capabilities** — root huquqi bo'lingan; **seccomp** — syscall filtr; **LSM** — MAC.
- Kernel **umumiy** → kernel CVE = container escape. Kuchliroq izolyatsiya: gVisor, Kata, Firecracker.
- Xavfli: `--privileged`, `-v /var/run/docker.sock` (= host root), `--pid=host`, `--cap-add SYS_ADMIN`.
- Hardening: `USER 10001`, `--read-only`, `--cap-drop ALL`, `--security-opt no-new-privileges`, rootless Docker / userns-remap, image scan (Trivy), digest bilan pin.

31396.a:
```
docker CLI --REST(unix socket)--> dockerd --gRPC--> containerd --> containerd-shim --> runc --> process
```
- **runc** — OCI runtime: container yaratadi va chiqib ketadi; jarayonga **shim** ota bo'lib qoladi → dockerd/containerd restart bo'lsa container o'lmaydi (`live-restore`).
- **OCI** standart: image spec + runtime spec → Docker image Podman/K8s'da ham ishlaydi.
- Kubernetes 1.24'dan dockershim olib tashlandi — kubelet to'g'ridan-to'g'ri containerd/CRI-O (CRI) bilan ishlaydi; image'lar o'zgarmadi.

31397.a:
- `nginx:1.27` keyin boshqa image'ga ko'chishi mumkin; `nginx@sha256:...` — aynan bir xil bayt.
- Pipeline: build → **SBOM** (syft) → **scan** (Trivy/Grype, CRITICAL'da fail) → **sign** (cosign) → registry → admission'da imzoni tekshirish.
- Minimal base: distroless/scratch — kam paket = kam CVE, shell yo'q.
- Secret'ni `ENV`/`ARG` bilan image'ga qo'yma — `docker history` ko'rsatadi. BuildKit: `RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc`.
- `latest` production'da — rollback va reproducibility yo'q.

31398.a:
```dockerfile
# yomon
RUN apt-get update
RUN apt-get install -y curl
# yaxshi
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
```
- Keyingi RUN'da `rm` qilish hajmni kamaytirmaydi — fayl oldingi layer'da qoladi.

31399.a:
- Docker published port `nat` jadvalida DNAT qiladi → paket `FORWARD` orqali o'tadi, ufw `INPUT` qoidalari ishlamaydi.
- Yechim: `-p 127.0.0.1:5432:5432`, yoki port publish qilmaslik (ichki network), yoki `DOCKER-USER` chain'ga qoida.
- DB'ni hech qachon `0.0.0.0` ga publish qilma.

31400.a:
```yaml
services:
  api:
    build: .
    ports: ["8080:8080"]
    environment:
      DB_URL: postgres://app:secret@db:5432/app
    depends_on: [db]
  db:
    image: postgres:16
    volumes: [pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data]
volumes:
  pgdata:
```
- `docker compose up -d`, `down`, `logs -f api`, `ps`, `exec db psql`.
- Compose v2 — `docker compose` (plugin), eski `docker-compose` (Python) deprecated; `version:` maydoni endi kerak emas.
- Bitta host; ko'p host/HA kerak bo'lsa — Swarm yoki Kubernetes.

31401.a:
- Default: `<project>_default` bridge network, hamma service unga ulangan.
- `api` ichidan `db:5432` — to'g'ri; `localhost:5432` — **noto'g'ri** (api o'zi).
- `ports` faqat host'dan kirish uchun kerak; service'lar o'zaro **container port** bilan gaplashadi (host port emas).
- Izolyatsiya: bir nechta `networks:` (frontend/backend) — db faqat backend'da.

31402.a:
- `stop` — to'xtatadi, container qoladi.
- `down` — container + network o'chadi; **volume qoladi**.
- `down -v` — volume'lar ham → ma'lumot yo'qoladi.
- `down --rmi all` — image'lar ham.
- Volume'siz DB (`volumes:` yo'q) — container o'chsa ma'lumot ketadi.

31403.a:
```yaml
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U app"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 10
  api:
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
  migrate:
    ...
  api2:
    depends_on:
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
```
- Production'da DB keyin restart bo'lishi mumkin — ilovada **retry/backoff** baribir shart.

31404.a:
- `.env` — **Compose fayliga** `${TAG:-latest}` qiymat beradi (container'ga avtomatik o'tmaydi).
- `env_file: [api.env]` — container env'iga.
- `environment:` — inline, env_file'dan ustun.
- Ustunlik: shell env > `.env` (interpolatsiyada).
- `${VAR:?xato}` — bo'lmasa fail. `docker compose config` — yakuniy YAML'ni ko'rish.
- Secret'lar uchun `secrets:` (fayl sifatida `/run/secrets/`), env'da emas.

31405.a:
```sh
docker compose up                        # compose.yaml + compose.override.yaml
docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml up -d
docker compose --profile debug up        # profiles: [debug] service'lar
```
- Override'da dev: bind mount kod, debug port, hot reload.
- Prod faylda: `restart: unless-stopped`, resurs limit, log rotation.
- `include:` — boshqa compose fayllarni qo'shish (monorepo).

31406.a:
- `docker compose up -d --build api` — faqat api'ni qayta build va recreate.
- `docker compose up -d --force-recreate` — config o'zgarmasa ham qayta yaratish.
- `develop.watch`:
```yaml
services:
  web:
    build: .
    develop:
      watch:
        - action: sync
          path: ./src
          target: /app/src
        - action: rebuild
          path: go.mod
```
- `docker compose watch`.

31407.a:
- `ports: ["8080:8080"]` + scale=3 → "port is already allocated". Yechim: port publish qilmaslik yoki diapazon `"8080-8082:8080"`.
- `container_name` belgilangan bo'lsa scale ishlamaydi.
- Ichki DNS `api` → bir nechta IP (round-robin), oldiga nginx/Traefik.
- Haqiqiy scaling/HA kerak bo'lsa Compose emas — Swarm/K8s.

31408.a:
- Kerakli: `restart: unless-stopped`, healthcheck, `deploy.resources.limits`, `logging: {driver: json-file, options: {max-size: 10m, max-file: "3"}}`.
- Image digest/aniq tag, `docker compose pull && up -d` — recreate paytida qisqa downtime.
- Zero-downtime: reverse proxy + blue/green (ikki service, proxy almashtirish).
- Backup: volume'larni muntazam (pg_dump), host o'lishi = hamma o'ladi.
- Trade-off: soddalik ↔ HA. 1 server, kichik trafik — Compose yetarli; bir necha node, SLA — K8s/Swarm/managed.

31409.a:
- Compose Specification bitta: `docker compose` (single host) va `docker stack deploy -c compose.yaml app` (Swarm).
- Stack'da: `build:` ishlamaydi (image registry'da bo'lishi kerak), `depends_on` e'tiborsiz, `container_name` yo'q.
- `deploy.update_config`, `placement.constraints`, `restart_policy` — Swarm'da to'liq ishlaydi.
- Kompose — compose → K8s manifest konvertori (boshlang'ich nuqta, production uchun qo'lda tozalash kerak).

31410.a:
```sh
docker swarm init --advertise-addr 10.0.0.1
docker swarm join-token worker
docker swarm join --token SWMTKN-... 10.0.0.1:2377
docker node ls
```
- **Manager** — Raft orqali holatni saqlaydi, scheduling, API. Default'da u ham task ishlatadi.
- **Worker** — faqat task bajaradi.
- Portlar: 2377/tcp (management), 7946/tcp+udp (gossip), 4789/udp (VXLAN overlay).

31411.a:
```sh
docker service create --name web --replicas 3 -p 80:80 nginx:1.27
docker service ls; docker service ps web
docker service scale web=5
docker stack deploy -c compose.yaml shop
docker stack services shop
```
- Desired state: task o'lsa, Swarm yangisini boshqa node'da ko'taradi (reconciliation).
- K8s analogi: service ≈ Deployment, task ≈ Pod, stack ≈ Helm release.

31412.a:
- `--mode replicated --replicas 3` (default).
- `--mode global` — har (mos keladigan) node'da 1 task; yangi node qo'shilsa avtomatik. K8s DaemonSet analogi.
- Misol: node-exporter, fluent-bit — global; API — replicated.

31413.a:
- `-p 80:80` → har node'ning :80 i ochiq, task bo'lmagan node ham qabul qilib forward qiladi.
- Ichkarida: service VIP + IPVS load balancing.
- Kamchilik: client IP yo'qoladi (SNAT), qo'shimcha hop.
- `--publish mode=host,target=80,published=80` — client IP saqlanadi, lekin faqat task bor node'da; global service + tashqi LB bilan.
- Tashqarida odatda LB (HAProxy/cloud LB) hamma node'lar oldida.

31414.a:
```yaml
deploy:
  replicas: 4
  update_config:
    parallelism: 1
    delay: 10s
    order: start-first      # yangisi ko'tarilib keyin eskisi o'chadi
    failure_action: rollback
    monitor: 30s
  rollback_config:
    parallelism: 2
```
```sh
docker service update --image api:1.3 shop_api
docker service rollback shop_api
```
- Healthcheck bo'lmasa Swarm "running" = muvaffaqiyat deb hisoblaydi — **healthcheck shart**.

31415.a:
```sh
printf 's3cret' | docker secret create db_pass -
docker service create --secret db_pass -e DB_PASS_FILE=/run/secrets/db_pass api
```
- Secret env'da emas, **faylda** — `docker inspect` da ko'rinmaydi.
- Immutable: rotation = `db_pass_v2` yaratish → `service update --secret-rm db_pass --secret-add source=db_pass_v2,target=db_pass`.
- `docker config` — nginx.conf kabi fayllar.

31416.a:
```sh
docker node update --label-add disk=ssd node-3
docker service create --constraint 'node.labels.disk==ssd' --constraint 'node.role==worker' postgres
docker service create --placement-pref 'spread=node.labels.zone' ...
```
- Constraint qondirilmasa task `Pending` turadi.
- `docker node update --availability drain node-2` — maintenance: task'lar boshqa node'larga ko'chadi.

31417.a:
| Manager | Quorum | Chidaydi |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 | 0 |
| 3 | 2 | 1 |
| 4 | 3 | 1 |
| 5 | 3 | 2 |
- 7 dan ko'p tavsiya etilmaydi — Raft yozuv latency oshadi.
- Manager'larni turli AZ'ga tarqat; production'da manager'larni `drain` qilib faqat boshqaruvga qoldir.
- Quorum yo'qolsa tiklash: tirik manager'da `docker swarm init --force-new-cluster`, keyin yangi manager'lar qo'shish. Raft holatini (`/var/lib/docker/swarm`) backup qil.

31418.a:
| | Swarm | Kubernetes |
|---|---|---|
| O'rganish | soat | hafta/oy |
| Konfiguratsiya | compose.yaml | ko'p manifest/Helm |
| Autoscaling | yo'q (built-in) | HPA/VPA/KEDA, cluster autoscaler |
| Stateful | cheklangan | StatefulSet, CSI, operatorlar |
| RBAC/multi-tenant | zaif | kuchli |
| Managed | deyarli yo'q | EKS/GKE/AKS |
- Tanlov: 3-10 node, bitta jamoa, oddiy stateless — Swarm yoki hatto Compose + LB. Ko'p jamoa, autoscaling, ekotizim kerak — K8s (iloji bo'lsa managed).

31419.a:
- Default `local` volume driver — har node'da alohida.
- Variantlar:
  1. `placement.constraints: [node.hostname==db-1]` — oddiy, lekin node o'lsa failover yo'q.
  2. Network storage (NFS, Portworx, CSI — Swarm 23+ da CSI qo'llovi cheklangan).
  3. DB'ni **tashqarida** (managed RDS yoki alohida VM) — ko'pincha eng to'g'ri.
- Replicated DB (Postgres primary/replica) ni Swarm'da qo'lda boshqarish — operator yo'q, xavfli.

33068.a:
```sh
docker login ghcr.io -u me --password-stdin < token.txt
docker build -t ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.0 .
docker push ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.0
docker pull ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.0
docker run -d -p 5000:5000 registry:2   # o'z registry
```
- Nomda registry bo'lmasa — `docker.io/library/...`.
- Docker Hub pull rate limit bor — CI'da mirror/cache yoki o'z registry.
- Credential `~/.docker/config.json` da — credential helper ishlat (plain base64 emas).

33069.a:
```sh
docker ps -a                 # hammasi, to'xtaganlar bilan
docker images
docker logs -f --since 10m api
docker exec -it api sh
docker rm -f api             # majburan o'chirish
docker rmi myapp:old
docker system df             # disk qancha band
docker system prune -a --volumes   # EHTIYOT: volume'lar ham
```
- `prune -a` ishlatilmayotgan **hamma** image'larni o'chiradi; `--volumes` — ma'lumot yo'qoladi.

33070.a:
```dockerfile
FROM golang:1.23 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o /app ./cmd/api

FROM gcr.io/distroless/static:nonroot
COPY --from=build /app /app
USER nonroot
ENTRYPOINT ["/app"]
```
- 900 MB → ~15 MB. `--target build` — faqat bitta bosqichni build qilish (test uchun).

33071.a:
```dockerfile
HEALTHCHECK --interval=10s --timeout=3s --start-period=20s --retries=3 \
  CMD wget -qO- http://localhost:8080/healthz || exit 1
```
- `docker inspect --format '{{.State.Health.Status}}' api`.
- Standalone Docker: unhealthy → faqat status, restart **yo'q** (Swarm restart qiladi).
- Kubernetes HEALTHCHECK'ni **e'tiborsiz** qoldiradi — u yerda probe'lar.
- Distroless'da `curl`/`wget` yo'q — ilovaning o'zida `-healthcheck` flag.

33072.a:
```sh
docker run --memory=512m --memory-swap=512m --cpus=1.5 --pids-limit=200 api
docker stats
docker inspect api --format '{{.State.OOMKilled}}'
```
- Limitsiz container host'ning butun RAM'ini yeyishi mumkin.
- Go: `GOMEMLIMIT` ni limitdan ~10% past qo'y; JVM: `-XX:MaxRAMPercentage`.
- CPU throttling latency p99'ni buzadi — `nr_throttled` ni kuzat.

33073.a:
```json
// /etc/docker/daemon.json
{ "log-driver": "local", "log-opts": { "max-size": "10m", "max-file": "3" } }
```
- O'zgarish faqat **yangi** container'larga ta'sir qiladi.
- Ilova faylga emas **stdout/stderr** ga yozsin (12-factor).
- Markaziy log: fluent-bit/Vector → Loki/Elastic.

33074.a:
```sh
docker system df -v
docker image prune            # dangling (<none>)
docker image prune -a --filter "until=168h"
docker container prune
docker builder prune --keep-storage 10GB
docker volume ls -f dangling=true    # avval ko'r, keyin o'chir
du -sh /var/lib/docker/containers/*/*-json.log | sort -h | tail
```
- Volume prune — ma'lumot yo'qolishi mumkin, avval tekshir.
- CI runner'larda cron bilan `builder prune`.

33075.a:
```
# .dockerignore
.git
node_modules
*.log
.env
dist
Dockerfile
```
- `.git` context'da bo'lsa — har commit `COPY . .` cache'ni buzadi.
- `.env` ignore qilinmasa — secret image layer'ida qoladi.
- `docker build -f docker/Dockerfile .` — context va Dockerfile alohida.

33076.a:
```sh
docker buildx create --use
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4 --push .
docker buildx imagetools inspect ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4
```
```dockerfile
FROM --platform=$BUILDPLATFORM golang:1.23 AS build
ARG TARGETOS TARGETARCH
RUN GOOS=$TARGETOS GOARCH=$TARGETARCH go build -o /app .
```
- Apple Silicon'da build qilingan image amd64 server'da `exec format error` beradi — platform aniq ko'rsat.

33077.a:
- **userns-remap** — daemon root, lekin container UID'lari `/etc/subuid` diapazoniga map.
- **Rootless** — daemon ham oddiy user'da; network slirp4netns/pasta (sekinroq).
- Podman default rootless, daemon'siz.
- Cheklovlar: privileged port (`net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start`), overlay filesystem, cgroup v2 delegation.
- Qachon: multi-tenant host, CI runner'lar, xavfsizlik talabi yuqori.

33078.a:
```sh
docker run --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v $PWD:/work img
```
- Teskari muammo: image'dagi user (UID 10001) host papkaga yoza olmaydi → `Permission denied`.
- UID raqam muhim, nom emas.

33079.a:
```dockerfile
ENTRYPOINT ["sh","-c","exec /app --port=$PORT"]
```
- Exec form'da `$PORT` kengaymaydi (shell yo'q) — `sh -c` kerak bo'lsa **exec** bilan.
- Tekshir: `docker exec api ps -o pid,cmd` — PID 1 ilova bo'lishi kerak.

33080.a:
- `docker run img:latest` — lokal nusxa bor bo'lsa ishlatadi.
- `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` yoki `--pull always`.
- To'g'ri yo'l: `api:1.4.2` yoki `api@sha256:...` — qaysi versiya ishlayotgani aniq, rollback oson.

33081.a:
```sh
docker compose up -d
docker compose ps
docker compose logs -f --tail=50 api
docker compose exec db psql -U app
docker compose run --rm api go test ./...   # bir martalik
docker compose restart api                  # compose.yaml o'zgarishini OLMAYDI
docker compose up -d api                    # o'zgarishni oladi (recreate)
docker compose config                       # yakuniy YAML
```

33082.a:
```yaml
services:
  web:
    ports: ["127.0.0.1:8080:80"]   # host -> container
  api:
    expose: ["9000"]               # faqat ichki
```
- Ichki service'lar (db, redis) uchun `ports` kerak emas — xavfsizroq.
- `"8080:80"` qo'shtirnoqda yoz — YAML `22:22` ni 60-lik son deb o'qishi mumkin.

33083.a:
```yaml
services:
  api:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: docker/Dockerfile
      args: { GO_VERSION: "1.23" }
      target: prod
    image: ghcr.io/acme/api:${TAG:-dev}
```
- `docker compose build && docker compose push` — CI'da shu nom bilan push.

33084.a:
```yaml
services:
```
